messages:
nina_support: Escalating SpruceBridge (org: 'spruce-bridge') - onboarding bulk ingest hitting 500/502 errors, activation blocked. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-5588
harper_cs: Oof. Blocked for all users? Any impact to billing/limits?
nina_support: Blocked for bulk jobs >10k docs. Router intermittently returns 502 and customers saw unexpected token usage spikes due to retry storms. SDK v2.5.0. Affected region: us-east-1 primary.
jordy_csm: I'll lead customer comms. Draft plan: 1) Immediate ack + apology 2) Offer temporary pause on billing for disputed window 3) Provide workaround (split job + lower concurrency) 4) 2pm ET bridge with eng + hourly updates 5) If >8h, offer onboarding credit and dedicated specialist.
kevin_eng: Quick triage: batch-aggregator node OOM when client-supplied batch_size > 16. Hotfix: enforce per-tenant max_batch=12 and add server-side soft-queueing. Canary ETA ~40m, full rollout ~2h.
infra_bot: Canary rollout started: job 123456 for batch-aggregator-canary. Monitor: https://ci.redwood.com/123456
harper_cs: Comm draft to PM: "Were aware and investigating. Short-term options: 1) re-run import with concurrency=6 and batch_size=8; 2) use resumable uploader (link). Were scheduling a 2pm ET bridge and will propose a billing pause while we investigate."
jordy_csm: Including a small ops snippet for their infra team - @kevin_eng please confirm syntax.
kevin_eng: Ops snippet to reduce batch size:
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/import \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <KEY>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"source":"s3://bucket/path","concurrency":6,"batch_size":8}'
Also can set header `X-Prefer-SoftQueue: true` to enable lower-memory path.
nina_support: Added workaround and monitoring checks to ticket: watch batch_oom.rate and tenant.error_rate. Will pause client auto-retries until metrics recover.
harper_cs: Flagged renewal_risk=ELEVATED if not resolved in 24h. Sending ack to customer now and scheduling 2pm ET bridge. Will post hourly status here. :white_check_mark:
jordy_csm: On bridge at 2pm. If canary fails, well prepare proposal for short-term dedicated onboarding capacity to finish their import.
